'''Dena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3642 BBY]]. [[Jaro Dev]] tried to contact her on the comlink, but was unable to reach her through [[White Maw]] interference.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dena is briefly mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' heroic quest "Signal Jam" on Hoth.
